title: Museum Ticket Discount
statement:
# Museum Ticket Discount

You buy N tickets. Each costs 60 coins. If N is at least 4, every ticket instead costs 45 coins. Output the total cost.

Input: one integer N (1 <= N <= 10).

Output: one integer, the total price.

Example: input `4`, output `180`.
reference_solution: Output N * (45 if N >= 4 else 60). Time O(1), extra space O(1).
proof: Every purchased ticket has the same applicable unit price by the statement. There are exactly N tickets, so multiplying the applicable price by N gives the total.
